summary: Bounded explicit multi-round N3 HALO population feedback: replay the one-round density feedback in source order over a caller-provided current-density sequence, enforce the marker-budget recurrence, and stop exactly at a source stop branch.

identity.relation: Ordered bounded feedback sequence: initialize previous/merged recurrence state from the caller's initial values, then per round call the one-round feedback operator with the fixed DCX seed density and base budget; the requested marker budget must follow the source recurrence (base budget at round 1, each previous round's next_halo_marker_count afterwards) and drift fails closed; after an accepted round previous <- current and merged <- merged + current; the sequence must end exactly at a source stop branch (density_growth_exceeded or seed_below_threshold).
identity.direction: DCX seed density + initial previous/merged HALO state + explicit current-density sequence + requested marker budgets + fixed base budget -> ordered per-round feedback records, terminal previous/merged/marker state with stop branch, and diagnostics
identity.definition: The saved FIDASIM DCXHalo迭代反馈序列图 TaskGraph (framework node N3 neutral_population_transport, src/fidasim.f90:13293-13420), composed from the integrated halo-iteration-feedback operator. The feedback is explicit and bounded: state, order, stop branches and the iteration bound (the provided sequence length) are declared; MC markers, plasma, track, colrad, reservoir, MPI and HDF5 producers stay outside this graph. The saved single-step delegation graph (DCXHalo迭代反馈图) is deliberately not ported as a separate asset: its ports equal the operator's contract one-to-one and add no composition, so that layer is folded into the operator document.
identity.model: composition of the named SciRel operator following the saved graph's node/edge contract; no new scientific rule is introduced in glue
identity.geometry: scalar population densities for one beam-grid cell or rank-local aggregation point, iterated over explicit generations
identity.coordinates: densities in cm^-3; marker counts dimensionless; the base budget is the fixed inputs%n_halo, not the previous round's actual count
identity.boundary: finite nonnegative current densities; positive DCX/previous; nonnegative initial cumulative density; positive integral base budget; nonnegative integral requested budgets matching the sequence length; the sequence must terminate at a source stop branch; no hidden state beyond the declared recurrence
assumptions: The caller owns the explicit current-generation density sequence in source order.
MC marker production, reservoir sampling and MPI/OpenMP scheduling remain caller-owned runtime mechanics.

preconditions: A caller-owned explicit current-generation density sequence in source order with its marker-budget recurrence.
supported: Bounded multi-round N3 HALO population-iteration feedback with explicit state, order, stop conditions and iteration bound.
excluded: MC marker production, plasma/track/colrad evaluation, reservoir sampling, MPI/OpenMP ownership, HDF5 writers, downstream terminals and whole-program parity.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when inputs is not a mapping or a required key is missing, when any scalar/vector contract is violated, when the requested budget vector mismatches the density sequence, when a requested budget drifts from the source recurrence, when inputs continue after a source stop branch, or when the sequence ends while the source would continue.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Propagates the feedback operator's fail-closed ValueError contracts, including the registered overflow gates.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable: there is no numerical convergence criterion; termination is the source's explicit stop branches, bounded by the provided sequence length, and an end without a stop branch fails closed rather than extrapolating.

Assemble the ordered records, terminal state and diagnostics from the per-round results; no scientific transformation.

execution.ordering: Initialize the recurrence state pair, then consume the caller's density sequence in source order; each round verifies the requested marker budget against the source recurrence, runs the one-round feedback operator, and updates previous/merged only after an accepted round; the graph returns when the operator reports a source stop branch.
branches: density_ratio > 1: the round exits before the merge (growth guard); the graph stops with stop_reason 'density_growth_exceeded'.
seed_dcx_fraction < 0.01 after an accepted round: the graph stops with stop_reason 'seed_below_threshold'.
Otherwise the graph continues to the next round while inputs remain; running out of inputs while continuing, or continuing after a stop, fails closed.
execution.state_ownership: The graph owns only the declared recurrence state pair (previous, merged) and the per-round record list; densities and budgets are caller-owned explicit inputs.
execution.failure_propagation: The feedback operator's ValueError contracts propagate directly; there is no extrapolation, fallback state or partial result.

feedback.initialization: From the caller's initial_previous_halo_density_cm3 and initial_merged_halo_density_cm3.
feedback.update_order: After an accepted round only (density_ratio <= 1): previous <- current, merged <- merged + current, in the source's merge addition order.
feedback.continue_when: The operator reports stop_reason 'continue' (seed_dcx_fraction >= 0.01) and further sequence inputs remain.
feedback.stop_when: The operator reports 'density_growth_exceeded' or 'seed_below_threshold'; the sequence must end exactly at that stop branch.
feedback.iteration_bound: The length of the caller-provided current_halo_densities_cm3 sequence; an end without a stop branch fails closed.
feedback.nonconvergence: Not applicable: no numerical convergence criterion; termination is the source's explicit stop branches.
